content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ  אֵל, אֲשֶׁר אֵין תִּכְלָה לְמַהֲלָלוֹ.
content.transliteration: Barukh El asher en tikhla lemahalalo.
content.english: Blessed is God, whose praise has no end.

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ  הַבֹּחֵר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל, לִהְיוֹתָם מְנָת חֶבְלוֹ.
content.transliteration: Barukh habboḥer beYisra’el, lihyotam menat ḥevlo.
content.english: Blessed is the one who chose Israel, for them to be the portion of His lot.

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ  רְבִיד תְּהִלָּה שָׂם לוֹ, וְהִגְדִּילוֹ.
content.transliteration: Barukh revid tehilla sam lo, vehiḡdilo.
content.english: Blessed is [the one who] gave them a necklace of praise, and made them great.
Blessed is [the one who] sent forth His voice in front of His army.

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ גָּזַר: יִהְיֶה נִפְקָד יֹצֵא צָבָא בְּדִגְלוֹ.
content.transliteration: Barukh gazar: Yihyē nifḳad yotsē tsava bediḡlo.
content.english: Blessed is [the one who] decreed: each one who goes out to battle shall be counted, in accordance with his [tribe’s] banner.

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ  אָמַר: מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים עַד חֲמִשִּׁים יִסְבֹּל עֻלּוֹ.
content.transliteration: Barukh amar: Mibben ‘esrim ‘ad ben ḥamish’shim yisbol ‘ullo.
content.english: Blessed is [the one who] said: [each man] shall bear his burden, from [age] twenty to fifty.

content.transliteration: Barukh hora lo bekhol davar vehiskilo.
content.english: Blessed is [the one who] instructed them regarding every matter, and enlightened them.

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ  בֵּין מַחֲנַֽיִם שָׂם לֵוִי וְהִגְבִּילוֹ.
content.transliteration: Barukh ben maḥanayim sam Levi vehiḡbilo.
content.english: Blessed is [the one who] placed Levi between two camps and bounded them.

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ  לְקָחוֹ תַּֽחַת בְּכוֹרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְהוֹד יָקָר הִנְחִילוֹ.
content.transliteration: Barukh leḳaḥo taḥat bekhorē Yisra’el, vehod yaḳar hinḥilo.
content.english: Blessed is [the one who] took them instead of the firstborns of Israel, and gave them glorious splendor as an inheritance.
Blessed is  [the one who] gave His temple’s vessels into their custody.
Blessed is [the one who] made it their portion to serve in His tent.

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ  לָשֵׂאת הָאָרוֹן בַּכָּתֵף הֱכִינָם, וְלֹא יִגְּעוּ לוֹ.
content.transliteration: Barukh laset ha’aron bakkatef hekhinam, velo yigge‘u lo.
content.english: Blessed is [the one who] appointed them to bear the Ark on their shoulders, without [directly] touching it.

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ  מְנָעָם מִלִּרְאוֹת כְבַלַּע אֶת־הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ, בְּחֶבְיוֹן גָּדְלוֹ.
content.transliteration: Barukh mena‘am millir’ot kevalla‘ et haḳḳodesh, beḥevyon godlo.
content.english: Blessed is [the one who] prevented them from seeing the holy, [lest they] be swallowed up by His concealed greatness.

content.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ  כִּי אֵין מִי יְמַלֵּל עֹז מִפְעָלוֹ.
content.transliteration: Barukh ki en mi yemallel ‘oz mif‘alo.
content.english: Blessed is [He]; indeed, no one can express His mighty deeds,

content.hebrew: קהל: בָּרוּךְ  עֹשֶׂה נִפְלָאוֹת בְּעֹז חֵילוֹ.
content.english: Cong. Blessed is [the one who] performs miracles with His mighty army.

content.hebrew: חזן: וּבָר֤וּךְ ׀ שֵׁ֥ם כְּבוֹד֗וֹ לְע֫וֹלָ֥ם וְיִמָּלֵ֣א כְ֭בוֹד֖וֹ אֶת־כָּל־הָאָ֗רֶץ אָ֘מֵ֥ן ׀ וְאָמֵֽן: (תהלים עב:יט)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Uvarukh, shem kevodo le‘olam veyimmale’ khevodo et kol ha’arets amen, ve’amen:
content.english: Cantor. And blessed be His glorious name forever, and may His Glory fill the whole land, Amen and Amen. (Ps. 72:19)
Cong. Blessed is Adonai’s Glory from His place. (Ezek. 3:12)
